title: The Truth About Weave! #haircare #weave
segments: There is no group of people that hate
themselves like black people. Why do you
put on Indian
human hair? Can I ask?
You know how we get that hair?
When nothing goes right in the life of a
Hindu person,
they go through a ceremony called
tonsure, where the priest in the temple
incantates all the bad luck they are
facing onto the hair because for them to
cut hair is such a taboo. But so that
they it indicates a new phase of
metamorphosis, they shave their head
clean. They used to burn that hair
because they understand the burning of
the bad luck until they realize the
stupid African women wants to put it on
their head.
So you buy your own bad luck and you put
it on your head. We should love
ourselves and love your people.
